items.html:
(to the question) The fifty gates of Bina within ZA
It is known that the fifty gates of Bina mean the five Gevurot of Ima, for each one includes ten, and they are fifty. And when they are in Katnut, they are fifty less one, that is, only forty-nine gates, and this indicates that they lack the head and the GAR, being only the seven lower ones. And each one includes all of them, making seven times seven, which are forty-nine. And these forty-nine gates expand in ZA at the time of its Katnut. And in Gadlut, the fiftieth gate also expands in it, which is their GAR. And this fiftieth gate, which he merits at the time of his Gadlut, is by the power of the garments of the upper Ima, which he received from the days of his pregnancy, which are ten garments for his five Hassadim and five Gevurot, called the ten Names of Ehyeh. (Part 1, Page 143, Item 58).
